entries.what: Got home from the Sunday night Ridgeline shift, ate eggs and rice, and slept until about 1 p.m. at Marisol Gardens unit 132.
entries.outcome: Got roughly five hours of sleep before class.

entries.what: First day of fall classes: afternoon section at Bayshore State, Tamsen campus, picking up syllabi for Exercise Physiology, Biomechanics, Stats 120 and Intro Psych. Fatima saved him a seat.
entries.outcome: Noted the midterm dates (Biomechanics Oct 16, Ex Phys Oct 22) in his phone.

entries.what: Checked his savings app and saw the emergency cushion sits near $480 against a $1,200 goal. Packed his bag for the night shift.
entries.outcome: Decided to keep the goal and not touch it.

entries.what: Biked to Ridgeline RF-4 for the 10 p.m. outbound night shift.
entries.outcome: Picked on the general floor without trouble.

entries.what: Finished the shift at 6:30 a.m. and lifted at Iron Flats Fitness at 6:45 before heading home to sleep.
entries.outcome: Got through the 5/3/1 session and slept by 8:30.

entries.what: Woke at 1 p.m., skipped class since Tuesday has no section, and did laundry and a grocery run. Arjun mentioned his internship spreadsheet again.
entries.outcome: Apartment stocked, and he nodded along to Arjun without comment.

entries.what: Sent Jade a goodnight text before biking to work for the shift.
entries.outcome: She replied with a short message about her clinic labs.

entries.what: Heat wave began. Marcus finished the night shift, where Ridgeline added extra water breaks on the floor.
entries.outcome: Got through it with only one mild lecture about rate.

entries.what: Slept poorly in the heat in a stuffy apartment, then dragged himself to the 2 p.m. afternoon section on a sweltering Tule Line train.
entries.outcome: Made it to class late and borrowed notes from Fatima.

entries.what: Ate chicken and rice at home, then biked to Ridgeline in the evening heat.
entries.outcome: Arrived on time for the 10 p.m. start.

entries.what: Night shift ended at 6:30 a.m. and the heat stayed brutal. Marcus skipped the gym and went straight home to sleep.
entries.outcome: Slept in short chunks.

entries.what: Thursday afternoon section: took notes during Biomechanics and fought to stay awake in the warm lecture hall.
entries.outcome: Fatima shared her notes doc after class.

entries.what: Had dinner with Arjun at the apartment and listened to him talk applications. Biked to work after.
entries.outcome: Kept the peace and left on time.

entries.what: Payday Friday: after the shift, picked up a Taquería Colima burrito for breakfast.
entries.outcome: The young counter girl took his order; he tipped a dollar.

entries.what: Lifted at Iron Flats Fitness on a Friday morning in the heat, then slept until early afternoon.
entries.outcome: Hit his working sets.

entries.what: Spent the afternoon at home resting, with Friday off from class. Cooled off by the apartment fan and texted Jade about the weekend.
entries.outcome: Agreed to dinner Saturday.

entries.what: Saturday morning lift at the gym after his shift, still 100 degrees outside by midday.
entries.outcome: Short session, then home to sleep.

entries.what: Slept through the hottest hours with the fan on high and woke up in the early afternoon.
entries.outcome: Felt rested enough for the evening.

entries.what: Saturday date night with Jade at Phở Bến Thành, hot soup despite the heat wave.
entries.outcome: Easy evening and Jade wasn't annoyed about his nights.

entries.what: Sunday: slept late, then spent the afternoon cleaning his sneakers and straightening the box wall in his closet.
entries.outcome: Shoes cleaned and boxes stacked.

entries.what: Went over his class syllabi and blocked out Stats 120 homework time for the week.
entries.outcome: Made a rough study plan.

entries.what: Rode to Ridgeline for the Sunday 10 p.m. start as the fog returned in the evening.
entries.outcome: Started the week on time.
